propositions: All structured-output consumers must route exclusively through the single PydanticAIRunner facade with one bounded Pydantic Agent run per output mode, replacing bespoke retry loops.

The structured_retry_limit knob controls output-repair retry allowance: a single value N seeds both Agent retries and request budget addend to guarantee output-retry counter trips before request budget exhaustion.

Structured retry is single-sourced via in-Agent bounded retry (retries={"output":N}), not a bespoke scheduler loop: well-formed first response executes exactly one agent.run_sync; bug-895c native→prompted downgrade executes exactly two.

structured_retry_limit=0 preserves single-shot fail-safe behavior with zero output-repair retries and zero budget addend, maintaining compatibility with overlap/judge.py and contracts.py batch abstain logic.

All in-tree structured consumers (plan_review, code_review, overlap/judge, enrich, epic_bug_screen, evals, workflow, scripts) and computed-mode callers must be verified via mode-resolving AST census to use the facade.
Provider fallback eligibility, tool surfaces, timeout/transport limits, provenance, and serialized output shapes remain unchanged; legacy compatibility and patch/import seams are preserved.
